race.comment: BOUJEE GOLD (6) brings the most progressive profile, having built through the campaign before winning a Maiden at Queanbeyan over 1460m on soft ground by 1.3L. The rise in trip looks no issue with the way she finished off last start. Can roll forward and bring up back-to-back wins. CHA CHA CHA (5) is the immediate danger after leading and being beaten just under a length at this track. Should be able to dictate from the front and be tough to run down. ASTROGAZER (1) comes off a better third at Muswellbrook, handles wet ground and returns to a distance where he has won. Just has to hold that form. BULLA VINAKA (4) resumes after jumping as favourite on the Acton last time out. Drawn nicely and can't be left out of calculations despite a long winning drought. CELESTIAL GRACE (2) is racing well and looks suited to the rise in distance.
